```
def _get_pretty_form_text(verbose_level):
    PRETTY_FORM_TEXTS = {
        'type_changes': 'Type of {diff_path} changed from {type_t1} to {type_t2} and value changed from {val_t1} to {val_t2}.',
        'dictionary_item_added': 'Item {diff_path} added to dictionary.',

        'iterable_item_added': 'Item {diff_path} added to iterable.',
        'iterable_item_removed': 'Item {diff_path} removed from iterable.',
        'attribute_added': 'Attribute {diff_path} added.',
        'attribute_removed': 'Attribute {diff_path} removed.',
        'set_item_added': 'Item {diff_path} added to set.',
        'set_item_removed': 'Item {diff_path} removed from set.',
        'values_changed': 'Value of {diff_path} changed from {val_t1} to {val_t2}.',
        'repetition_change': 'Repetition change for item {diff_path}.',
    }
    return PRETTY_FORM_TEXTS
```

```
def pretty_print_diff(diff):
    type_t1 = get_type(diff.t1).__name__ if diff.t1 is not None and get_type(diff.t1) is not type(None) else 'None'
    type_t2 = get_type(diff.t2).__name__ if diff.t2 is not None and get_type(diff.t2) is not type(None) else 'None'

    val_t1 = '"{}"'.format(diff.t1) if isinstance(diff.t1, str) else diff.t1
    val_t2 = '"{}"'.format(diff.t2) if isinstance(diff.t2, str) else diff.t2

    diff_path = diff.path(root='root')

    pretty_form_texts = _get_pretty_form_text(verbose_level=2)

    report_type = diff.report_type

    template = pretty_form_texts.get(report_type, 'Unknown change at {diff_path}.')

    return template.format(
        diff_path=diff_path,
        type_t1=type_t1,
        type_t2=type_t2,
        val_t1=val_t1,
        val_t2=val_t2,
    )
```

```
def pretty(self, prefix: Optional[Union[str, Callable]]=None):
    result = []
    if prefix is None:
        prefix = ''
    keys = sorted(self.tree.keys())
    for key in keys:
        for item_key in self.tree[key]:
            result += [pretty_print_diff(item_key)]

    if callable(prefix):
        return "\n".join(f"{prefix(diff=item_key)}{r}" for r, item_key in zip(result, [item for key in sorted(self.tree.keys()) for item in self.tree[key]]))
    return "\n".join(f"{prefix}{r}" for r in result)
```
